home.heroTitle: Upload your file. Get an exact print price in seconds.
home.heroSub: PDF page counting right in your browser, transparent quantity discounts, and fast pickup or delivery across Cairo & Egypt.
home.stepsSub: Four clean steps from document to printed stack.
home.step1Desc: Drop your PDF, images, or Office file. PDF pages are counted locally before uploading.
home.step2Desc: Choose A5/A4/A3, B&W or vivid CMYK color, single or double-sided, and binding.
home.step3Desc: See the exact breakdown with automatic bulk copy discounts — no hidden fees.
home.step4Desc: Submit directly to our print queue and optionally send your order summary via WhatsApp.
home.servicesSub: Built for students, offices, clinics, and agencies.
home.srv1Desc: Crisp laser B&W and color printing on 80gsm–300gsm paper with automatic volume tiers.
home.srv2Desc: Corner stapling, spiral coil binding with clear covers, thermal lamination, and trimming.
home.srv3Desc: Bulk A4 copy paper cartons, refill inks, toners, and binding coils ready to ship.
